defendant: SALLY BAKSH AKA SALLY YABRA, ET ALS.
description:
The property to be sold is located in the TOWNSHIP OF EDISON in the County of MIDDLESEX, and the State of New Jersey.
Tax Lot 6, 7 & 8 Block 320
Commonly known as 102 Gracey Street, Edison, New Jersey 08817
Dimensions of the Lot are (Approximately) 75 x 100 x 75 x 100
Nearest Cross Street: Player Avenue
Subject to Mortgage held by Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, as Trustee for the Holders
of the Merrill Lynch Mortgage Investors Trust, Mortgage Loan Asset-Backed Certificates, Series
2006-WMCI in the amount of $90,000 dated August 1 1, 2005 and recorded October 5, 2005 in
Book 10986, Page 883 within the Clerk's Office of Middlesex County
The sale is subject to unpaid taxes and assessments, tax, water and sewer liens and other municipal assessments. The amount due can be obtained from the local taxing authority. Pursuant to NJSA 46:8B-21 the sale may also be subject to the limited lien priority of any condominium/homeowner association liens which may exist. The sale may be further subject to Restrictions, reversions, reservations, and easements of record.
The occupancy status of the subject property is unknown.
Surplus Money: if after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if ally
The approximate upset sum is $720,135.06 calculated through August 29, 2025 plus any additional advance, interest, Sheriffs cost and commission to the date of sale.
